Global Scientist Interdisciplinary Forum • Autumn 2026

Southern University of Science and Technology

School of Medicine & School of Public Health and Emergency Management

1. Introduction  

The Global Scientist Interdisciplinary Forum at Southern University of Science and Technology (SUSTech) School of Medicine and School of Public Health and Emergency Management is an important conference for talent recruitment. It aims to provide a platform for academic exchanges among domestic and international scholars, promote interdisciplinary and academic innovation, and discuss the approaches for building towards a world-class medical school. Through the recruitment of world-class faculty, we strive to establish School of Medicine at SUSTech as a well-respected research-oriented modern medical institution with unique distinction in the world.

2. Forum Schedule  

Date of Forum: Tentatively scheduled for late November or December, 2026

3. Positions to Recruit  

Senior Faculty (Chair Professor / Professor)  
Junior Faculty (Associate / Assistant professor)  

4. Application  

Please submit your complete CV and research plan to the mailbox of Human Resources Office of School of Medicine (hr-med@sustech.edu.cn), or to the mailbox of Human Resources Office of School of Public Health & Emergency Management（hr.sph@sustech.edu.cn）for public health disciplines, entitled “SUSTech Global Scientist Interdisciplinary Forum Application-School of Medicine-Senior Faculty/Junior Faculty” (please choose one from these two positions) for evaluation. We will evaluate the application materials and send out interview invitations to the qualified candidates. Please send materials at your earliest convenience as the invitation slots are limited.

6. Qualifications and Benefits  

Senior Faculty (Chair Professor / Professor)  

1. Requirements   

Internationally recognized tenured professor or associate professor with outstanding academic and professional accomplishments from well-known universities or research institutions.  

2.Support  

Research funds：decision made case by case.  

3.Remuneration  

Salary: Globally competitive salary; Potential benefits of reduced individual income tax: income tax of highly qualified individual will be compensated by local government to a maximum of 15%.  

Insurances: Shenzhen’s highest level of retirement insurance, medical insurance, unemployment insurance, industrial injury insurance, maternity insurance and housing provident funds. Special high-level health insurance is negotiable.  

4.Benefits  

Housing and subsidies: Temporary on-campus apartments provided or subsidies to support off-campus rental housing. The university will assist in applying for the corresponding support programs according to the national, provincial and municipal policies. Successful personnel will receive the relevant project funding / award.  

Other benefits: Permanent residence or resident visa service for scholars and family (spouse and children) for those who hold foreign visas; The university will facilitate children’s education enrollment and spouse’s employment.  

Junior Faculty (Associate / Assistant professor)   

1. Requirements    

M.D./Ph.D. degrees obtained from internationally renowned universities and institutes, with a formal teaching or research position in well-known domestic or overseas universities and research institutes.   

2. Support  

Research funds: Funding will be provided according to relevant policies, which is on par with international standards.  

Eligible to participate in the postgraduate enrollment of Biology and Clinical Medicine as a mentor.  

3. Remuneration  

Salary: Globally competitive salary; Potential benefits of reduced individual income tax: income tax of qualified individuals will be compensated by local government to a maximum of 15%.  

Insurances: Shenzhen’s highest level of retirement insurance, medical insurance, unemployment insurance, industrial injury insurance, maternity insurance and housing provident funds. Special high-level health insurance is negotiable.  

4. Benefits   

Housing and subsidies: Temporary on-campus apartments provided or subsidies to support off-campus rental housing. The university will assist in applying for the corresponding support programs according to the national, provincial and municipal talent policies. Successful personnel will receive the relevant project funding / award.  

Other benefits: Permanent residence or resident visa service for scholars and family (spouse and children) for those who hold foreign visas; The university will facilitate children’s education enrollment and spouse’s employment.  

Introduction of Southern University of Science and Technology  

Southern University of Science and Technology (SUSTech) is an innovation-oriented public university founded by Shenzhen government in support of China's higher education reform. It is committed to serving the mission of promoting Shenzhen as a modern, international, and innovative city and China as a creative high-tech country.

SUSTech is widely regarded as a trailblazer and innovator in advancing China's higher education. It was officially approved by the Ministry of Education in April 2012. SUSTech focuses on science, engineering, and medicine in conjunction with distinctive disciplines, including business, humanities, and social sciences. SUSTech offers undergraduate and postgraduate education and aims at a globally renowned university that contributes to the advancement of science and technology. It nurtures promising and creative leaders who excel in interdisciplinary research and creating knowledge for the world.

SUSTech also seeks to become a world-class research university that gathers first-class faculty and nurtures top-notch innovative talents. It aims to produce internationally recognized academic achievements and advance scientific and technological applications.

SUSTech is a public research university in the city of Shenzhen, known for its rapid rise, in less than 40 years, from a fishing village to a major center in Asia for finance, commerce, transportation, manufacturing, research and technology. Established 11 years ago, SUSTech has already been recognized as one of the best universities in the world among the colleges established within the last 50 years and has been ranked among the top ten universities in China. SUSTech aspires to be a globally-renowned university that contributes significantly to the advancement of science and technology by excelling in interdisciplinary research, nurturing creative future leaders and creating knowledge for the world.

Introduction of School of Medicine of Southern University of Science and Technology

The School of Medicine at the Southern University of Science and Technology strives to build a first-class research medical school in Shenzhen to meet the needs of China. Our highest mission is to cultivate top-notch innovative talents with international vision and the courage to pioneer; and to explore the future of medicine, lead the development of disciplines, and create advanced diagnosis and treatment models. The current dean of the School of Medicine is Professor Songling Wang, Academician of the Chinese Academy of Sciences, a famous physician scientist in China.

1. Department development 

The school has established five academic departments, including Department of Pharmacology, the Department of Biochemistry, the Department of Medical Neurosciences, the Department of Human Cell Biology, and the Department of Physiology and Pathophysiology. Three undergraduate programs－Clinical Medicine, Biomedical Science, and Dental Medicine, and three graduate programs–Clinical Medicine, Biology, and Biomedical and Pharmaceutical Sciences (Professional) have been established. The school has three distinctive research institutes, including Institute of Advanced Biotechnology, Homeostasis Medicine Institute, and Institute of Health and Medicine.

2. Faculty resources  

The School of Medicine currently has 226 full-time employees. Teachers have obtained about 180 talent titles at national, provincial or municipal level, and 58% of faculty members were awarded with national talent titles.

3. Research results  

In its short history, the school has achieved outstanding accomplishments in research, which continues to grow rapidly. As of August 2026, the school, including affiliated hospitals, published 5417 articles, had 741 grants totaling over 736 million yuan. The School of Medicine has established several laboratories, including four at provincial level, three at municipal level, four at university level, and three at school level.

4. Clinical teaching bases  

At present, the clinical teaching affiliated hospital system of SUSTech has basically taken shape, and the school has gradually established an efficient 'medical-education-research-industry' collaboration with its affiliated hospitals, teaching partner hospitals, and research cooperation bases.

For more information, please visit: https://med.sustech.edu.cn/en

Introduction to the SUSTech School of Public Health and Emergency Management  

SUSTech School of Public Health and Emergency Management was founded in April 2020, in the midst of the COVID-19 pandemic. The school serve as an important deployment by SUSTech and Shenzhen Health Commission to address major global public health challenges, respond to the “Healthy China” Strategy, and address the fulfillment of people’s healthcare needs.

SUSTech School of Public Health and Emergency Management was jointly established by SUSTech, the Shenzhen Center for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC), and the Second Affiliated Hospital of SUSTech (National Clinical Research Center for Infectious Diseases). School of Public Health and Emergency Management has maintained close collaboration with its co-founding institutes, which provide tremendous opportunities for engagement in interdisciplinary research with frontline medical and public health experts. It is committed to becoming a dual base for the training of backbone talents in the field of public health in China and international high-level scientific research, a new think tank and a model of international cooperation and a cutting-edge applied discipline serving economic construction and social development.

We are now recruiting high-level, high-standard, and high-quality scholars and talents in China and abroad, with focus on disciplinary development in the Application of Big data, artificial intelligence in public health, preventive medicine, precision medicine and disease management, Epidemiology and Biostatistics, Environmental Health, Nutrition and Food Safety, Chronic Disease Prevention and Smart Health Management, Microbiology for Public Health, Prevention and Control of Infectious and Emerging Infectious Diseases, Public Health Emergency Management and Global Health.
